skill.name: banner-design

security_audit.summary: Most static findings mistake Markdown backticks, file references, dimensions, and design prose for shell execution or system reconnaissance. The workflow does invoke external helper scripts and directs Pinterest browsing, creating moderate dependency and network exposure without evidence of malicious intent.

remediation.issue: The workflow executes helper scripts from neighboring skill directories whose integrity is not established by this package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin trusted dependency versions, verify script paths and hashes, and request confirmation before running external helpers.

remediation.issue: Pinterest research sends campaign search terms to an external service and imports untrusted page content.
remediation.suggestion: Make external research optional, disclose the destination, minimize sensitive query details, and treat retrieved content as untrusted.

content.value_statement: Creating consistent banners across platforms requires precise dimensions, safe zones, and clear art direction. This skill guides concept creation, composition, and image export.
actual_capabilities: Collects purpose, platform, dimensions, content, brand, style, and quantity requirements.
Provides platform dimensions and safe-zone guidance for social, web, display, and print banners.
Develops multiple art directions from 22 documented visual styles.
Guides HTML and CSS composition with typography, contrast, CTA, and brand rules.
Uses compatible image-generation skills for backgrounds, illustrations, and product visuals.
Exports local HTML banner designs to dimensioned PNG files through a screenshot workflow.
limitations: Requires separate design, image-generation, multimodal, and browser screenshot skills.
Does not handle video editing, complete website design, or physical print production.
Platform specifications can change and should be verified before final delivery.
External image generation and Pinterest research may require network access and service credentials.

use_cases.title: Prepare Social Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Create coordinated covers, headers, posts, and stories with platform-specific dimensions and brand-safe layouts.

use_cases.title: Build Display Ad Variants
use_cases.description: Produce several visual directions and sizes for campaign testing while keeping one clear call to action.

use_cases.title: Design Website Hero Graphics
use_cases.description: Compose a branded hero banner with generated visuals, readable text, and a responsive content safe area.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Social Banner
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [platform] banner for [purpose]. Use [headline], [brand colors], and [style]. Provide three concepts at the correct dimensions.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has a clear platform and basic campaign message.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Campaign Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this campaign into [platform list]. Preserve [brand elements], apply each safe zone, and export named PNG variants.
prompt_templates.scenario: A campaign needs consistent assets in several formats.

prompt_templates.title: Develop Competing Art Directions
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop three distinct directions for [campaign]. Compare [style choices], typography, composition, imagery, CTA placement, and suitability for [audience].
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs meaningful creative options for stakeholder review.

prompt_templates.title: Produce an Advanced Banner System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable banner system for [brand] across [formats]. Apply supplied guidelines, generate supporting visuals, validate contrast, and organize final exports.
prompt_templates.scenario: An experienced team needs a governed multi-format asset set.

output_examples.input: Create three LinkedIn company cover concepts for a security software launch.
output: Minimalist concept with product message, restrained brand colors, and central safe-zone placement.
Editorial concept with structured typography, customer proof, and a single launch CTA.
Geometric concept with abstract security forms, high contrast, and a 1128 by 191 pixel export.

output_examples.input: Adapt a summer campaign into an Instagram post and story.
output_examples.output: Two coordinated compositions with adjusted safe zones, concise copy, consistent imagery, and exports sized for square and vertical placements.

output_examples.input: Design a website hero for a new analytics product.
output_examples.output: A 1920-pixel-wide hero concept with product-focused imagery, readable headline hierarchy, one CTA, and documented design rationale.

best_practices: Provide final copy, platform, dimensions, brand assets, and audience before concept development.
Keep critical content inside each platform safe zone and verify text contrast before export.
Review every generated visual for brand accuracy, licensing concerns, and unwanted text or artifacts.
anti_patterns: Do not use one layout unchanged across platforms with different crops and interface overlays.
Do not place multiple competing calls to action or long paragraphs in compact banners.
Do not run external research or generation tools with confidential campaign details without approval.

faq.question: Which banner formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill covers common social headers, social posts, display ads, website heroes, email headers, and several print banner formats.

faq.question: Can it create several visual directions?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow recommends multiple concepts selected from documented styles such as minimalist, editorial, geometric, photo-based, and bold typography.

faq.question: Does it generate finished image files?
faq.answer: It can guide PNG export when the required image-generation, local server, and browser screenshot tools are available.

faq.question: Can it follow existing brand guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide brand colors, typography, logo rules, imagery guidance, and approved copy before generation.

faq.question: Does it support print production?
faq.answer: It provides dimensions, DPI, bleed, and CMYK guidance, but it does not manage printers or complete production checks.

faq.question: Does the skill require network access?
faq.answer: Network access may be needed for Pinterest research and external image-generation services. Local HTML composition and screenshot export can remain local.
